blocks.text: Space complexity naapti hai ke input data ka size barhne par algorithm jitni memory (space) istemal karta hai woh kaise badalti hai. Is se samajh aata hai ke zyada data hone par algorithm memory ko kitni efficiency se istemal karta hai.
Misal: agar algorithm ko numbers ki list store karni ho, to us ki space complexity batati hai ke numbers barhne par kitni memory chahiye hogi.

Space complexity samajhna is liye ahem hai ke is se algorithm ki memory ki zaroorat ka andaza hota hai. Memory ka efficient istemal bohat zaroori hai, khaas taur par bare (large-scale) applications ya aise systems mein jin ke paas memory kam hai.
Space complexity ka jaiza kaise liya jata hai

Space complexity bhi aam taur par time complexity ki tarah Big O notation mein likhi jati hai. Yeh batati hai ke input size barhne par algorithm zyada se zyada (upper limit) kitni memory istemal karega. Kuch aam misalein:

items: O(1) Constant Space: algorithm input ke size se qata-e-nazar muqarrar (fixed) memory istemal karta hai. Maslan aisa saada algorithm jise darmiyani (intermediate) qeematein rakhne ke liye sirf chand variables chahiyein.
O(n) Linear Space: memory ka istemal input ke size ke saath seedha barhta hai. Maslan algorithm ko items ki list store karni ho to memory items ki tadaad ke saath barhti hai.

O(n²) Quadratic Space: input barhne par memory quadratically barhti hai. Maslan n x n size ki matrix (khaanon ki jadwal) store karne wala algorithm, kyun ke matrix ke elements n ke square ke saath barhte hain.

O(log n) Logarithmic Space: memory logarithmically, yani input ke muqable mein bohat aahista, barhti hai. Maslan divide-and-conquer strategies istemal karne wale kuch algorithms ki space complexity logarithmic ho sakti hai, kyun ke unhein har qadam par data ka sirf chhota hissa rakhna hota hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Big O notation computer scientists ko worst case (sab se buri soorat) mein algorithm ki efficiency samajhne mein madad deta hai, taake woh andaza laga sakein ke input data barhne par algorithm kaisa chalega.

blocks.prompt: Time aur space complexity ke farq aur algorithm chunne par un ke asar par baat kijiye (long question 7).
blocks.explanation: Time complexity naapti hai ke input ke saath waqt kaise barhta hai; space complexity naapti hai ke memory ka istemal kaise barhta hai. Koi algorithm tez magar zyada memory wala, ya kam memory wala magar sust ho sakta hai, is liye intikhab hadon (limits) par munhasir hai: tez server par bohat bare data ke liye waqt sab se ahem hai, jabke kam memory wale aale (device) par O(1)-space algorithm behtar ho sakta hai chahe sust ho. Maslan Merge Sort O(n log n) waqt leta hai magar merge karne ke liye izafi memory chahta hai, jabke Bubble Sort sirf O(1) izafi memory leta hai magar O(n²) waqt.

items: Space complexity: memory ki barhotri (O(1) chand variables, O(n) list, O(n²) n x n matrix, O(log n)).
Waqt aur memory ki hadon mein tawazun kar ke algorithm chunein.
